name: Queue Horn
summary: Hear and see it the moment your dungeon group, ready check, battleground or pet battle pops, even while you are tabbed out.
logoPrompt: A curved brass hunting horn with a polished glowing rim, lying slightly tilted in the centre, with soft rings of sound rising from its bell

cover.tagline: Never miss a queue pop again.

description: **Queue Horn makes sure you notice when your group is ready, even when you are tabbed out or the game sound is turned down.**
## Features
- Alerts when the Dungeon Finder or Raid Finder has a group for you.
- Alerts on a ready check someone else starts, and when a battleground, arena or pet battle match is ready.
- One sound on the Master channel, a flashing game icon in your taskbar or dock and a short message in the middle of the screen.
- Each alert and the icon flash can be switched off.
## How to use
Install it and queue up. Type `/qh` (or `/queuehorn`) to see the settings and commands, and `/qh test` to hear and see the alert once.
## In detail
### The queue pop sound

Every alert plays the game's ready check sound on the Master channel, so it comes through even when the effects volume is turned down or muted. At the same time the game icon flashes in your taskbar or dock, and a short line such as "Your group is ready!" appears in the middle of the screen, where raid warnings show. The same kind of alert never plays twice within 5 seconds.
### What triggers an alert
- Dungeon Finder and Raid Finder: the moment a group is proposed to you.
- Ready check: when a group member starts one. Your own ready checks stay silent.
- Battleground and arena: when a queue becomes ready to enter. Each pop is announced once, and a queue that is already waiting after a reload does not ring again.
- Pet battle: when the pet battle queue finds a match.
### Hearing it while tabbed out
The game only plays sound in the background when "Sound in Background" is on in its sound options. When it is off, you hear nothing while tabbed out, and `/qh` reminds you of it.
### Commands
- `/qh` – shows which alerts and the flash are on.
- `/qh test` – plays the alert once.
- `/qh lfg off` or `on` – Dungeon Finder and Raid Finder alert.
- `/qh ready`, `/qh pvp` and `/qh pet` with `on` or `off` – the other alerts.
- `/qh flash off` or `on` – the flashing game icon.
## Good to know
- Works on Retail only. No combat data and no window.
- Everything is on by default.
- The addon is in English.
- It saves only the switches, shared by all your characters.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
